scope.summary: Implement books binding multiple chapter StudioDocuments into one publication unit sharing numbering and output. Book surface: add/remove/reorder documents, designate a style-source document, show per-document status, open documents from the book list. Book synchronization propagates selected categories from the style-source document across book documents: styles (with smart style-group matching), swatches, text variables, numbered lists, cross-reference formats, conditional-text conditions, parent pages, and trap presets. Book numbering continues page and chapter numbering across documents (continue, continue-on-next-odd/even with inserted blanks), updates on demand, and supports disabling automatic numbering; numbered lists continuable across stories and book documents for figure/table numbering. Book-wide output prints, exports (PDF/reflowable), preflights, and packages the whole book or selected documents.
acceptance_criteria: books bind chapters with shared numbering + category sync from style-source + book-wide output
proof_targets: book numbering-continuation + sync runtime; book-wide output test
expected_tests: live: book binds chapters, continues numbering across documents (continue-on-next-odd with blank insertion), sync propagates styles/swatches/variables from style-source
test: book-wide preflight/package/export over selected documents

risk_if_missed: No multi-chapter publications; cross-document numbering and synchronized styling impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
